bullets.text: Public blocked roads at night in Kannigaipair near Periyapalayam in Thiruvallur district protesting severe power cuts, and the office should monitor electricity restoration.
Motorists are fearful as a high-level bridge across the Arani river near Ponneri is damaged, and the office should urge immediate repair work.
College students assaulted a government bus conductor in Avadi after he questioned them, and the office should monitor police action.
A 44-year-old man from Puzhal named Saravanan was run over by a truck after falling from his two-wheeler in Madhavaram.
Two cows and a deer died due to electrocution in the Anuppampattu area near Ponneri, and the office should ensure safety checks.
A special education loan camp for students is being held today at the Thiruvallur Government Hospital campus.
Vyoma.AI held a groundbreaking ceremony for a 52 MW AI-ready green data center featuring liquid cooling in Chennai, India.
Reddit is testing advertisements in its search results as it faces declining traffic from traditional Google searches and AI competition.
